info.title: Moments API
info.description: Configurable read and Clerk-protected administration API for a personal Moments site, with D1-backed feature settings and maintenance operations.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Public post reads (feed, date mode, random) and administrator mutations.

tags.name: Statistics
tags.description: Aggregated posting statistics and administrator maintenance.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Public runtime settings and administrator updates.

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Administrator backup and destructive data maintenance.
